purpose: Second-draft enabled MVP controls for the piecemeal proto/public website.
scope_included_from_user_list: Name/label uploaded and displayed image assets for readable dropdown selection.
notes: The v2 UI enables basic MVP file writes for only the user-requested operations.
The public architecture model is still plain PHP and no framework or build step is introduced.
language.json archive files are intentionally out of scope, except new backups generated when edited files are written.
Template changes are conservative MVP writes: notes can be appended and image handles can be patched in selected route templates.
Section-corner overlays are decorative GEN media controls pinned by image center to a selected primary section corner with X/Y offsets.
Image labels are stored in draft/published state under image_labels and are display labels only; filenames remain the saved asset values.
